description.value: Society at the Hall in Maple Bay is a multi-concept venue combining a full-service barbershop with a coffee cafe (NOTACAFE) and a tequila-and-local-beer bar (NOTABAR), all under the family-owned NOTACULT LLC umbrella. The bar serves daily baked goods and savory pies alongside a curated selection of tequilas and local craft beers from breweries like Red Arrow, Deadhead, Hoyne, and Driftwood. It is one of several locations operated by founders Ian and Rhiannon, with the head office and main barbershop in downtown Duncan.

address.value: 963 Herd Rd, Maple Bay, BC V9L 5W9
